Deploy modes and launch paths Preview

Two questions trip up first-time operators: "how do I actually deploy the platform?" and "the CodePipeline is the default — so when does it run?" This page is the map. The platform itself is deployed by a manual CLI step; the CodePipeline is for rolling out tenant stacks, not for standing up the platform.

Two deploy modes

  • Lite mode — make deploy. A single organizer running one event. It skips the SBT control plane, tenant pipeline, and System Admin invitation entirely and deploys just two stacks via infrastructure/bin/tenkacloud-lite.ts: AppPlaneCore (tenantId="local") plus the problem-deploy backend / participant portal. There is no CodePipeline in Lite mode. Teardown is make destroy.
  • SaaS mode — make deploy-saas (scripts/install.sh, three phases). Full multi-tenant operation: pooled BASIC / ADVANCED tiers, the PLATINUM silo tier, and System Admin invitations. Teardown is make destroy-saas.

Both modes are run by an operator from a shell. CI never deploys.

How a new tenant is provisioned

New-tenant provisioning and pipeline rollout are different paths — this is the distinction the old docs got wrong.

  • A tenant creation event (onboardingRequest) is picked up by the SBT BashJobRunner, which runs provision-tenant.sh. By default the tenant is pooled (it shares the pooled stack); only a PLATINUM tier tenant gets a dedicated silo stack deployed directly (bun cdk deploy tenkacloud-tenant-template-<id>).

So creating one tenant does not run the CodePipeline; it runs a provisioning job.

What the SaaS pipeline is for

tenkacloud-saas-pipeline (CodePipeline) exists to roll out tenant stacks across every existing tenant, not to create one. Its source is an S3 object (source.zip, uploaded by prepare-source-bundle.sh during make deploy-saas) that the pipeline polls; on a change it walks the tenant list from DynamoDB and deploys / updates each tenant stack in waves (a Step Functions WaveIterator driving CodeBuild). New-tenant creation and existing-tenant rollout therefore travel different routes.

How a problem deploys

When an organizer clicks Deploy in the console:

  1. The console calls the Deploy API, which validates the request, writes a row to the Deployments table, and puts a DeployCreateRequested event on the bus.
  2. A Step Functions execution starts a CodeBuild job (.sync).
  3. The worker assumes a role into the competitor account using the tenant's ExternalId (always required) and runs a CloudFormation CreateStack there.

The console then polls deployment status until the stack reaches a terminal state.

Problem packs

Problem packs (see the first pack tutorial) ride the Lite path only. Lite reads activations for the fixed tenant id local at synth time, so activate with --tenant local before make deploy. SaaS mode fails loud at synth instead when any pack activation exists — it does not silently drop them from the pooled catalog. Set CDK_PARAM_SAAS_IGNORE_PACKS=true to override and proceed anyway; the activations then simply do not appear in any tenant's catalog.
